notes.title: Haunt Monster 0.5.7: Congo Forest (Semi OpenWorld Map)
notes.notes:
Hello, 

Haunt Monster 0.5.7: Congo Forest (Semi OpenWorld Map) is now released. We have added new semi openworld map, new dog and new SWAT team. We have focused on Explore mode. We also fixed many bugs.

We have released a demo. Now, everyone can play the demo, review the game and share it with friends!

[previewyoutube=hMOdtoBX0F4;full][/previewyoutube]

What's new:
+ New semi openworld map: Congo Forest
+ New companions such as: Dog, Swat Melee, Swat Shoot.
+ New boss
+ Added Army Truck to unlock the map
+ Improved AI to be smarter
+ Update performance better
+ Fixed all known bugs

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961960/Haunt_Monster/

Join newsletter: https://sango.games/haunt-monster/


Thanks for playing Haunt Monster!

notes.title: Haunt Monster 0.4.9: A Big Offline Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

Haunt Monster 0.4.9: A Big Offline Update is now released. We have added new maps, new objects and new weapons. We have focused on improving Offline mode. We also fixed many bugs and improved a few functions.

We will release a demo soon in June.

[previewyoutube=l2qzOUEhNh0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What's new:[/h3]
+ 10 maps updated such as: Caford Factory, Khumbu Valley, North Ice and more
+ 20 weapons updated such as: Steyr TMP, Beretta M9, ​​RPK16 and more
+ 15 objects updated such as: Fire Turret, Ice Freezer and more
+ Added gun weight function when character moves
+ Added gun accuracy function
+ Improved AI to be smarter
+ Update performance better
+ Upgrade the environment, sound and lighting are better
+ Fixed all known bugs

Update it to enjoy the latest improvements and features!

Thank you and have fun!
